annotations.title: Work out a tarot birth card

description:
Reduces a birth date to its tarot birth card by this site's own rule, with 11, 22 and 33 held as master numbers, returning the card, its Roman numeral and every step of the arithmetic. It covers a birth, life or destiny card. The date alone decides it.

The method: sum the year's digits, add day and month, and reduce the same way; the reduction halts on 11, 22 and 33, which are read through roots 2, 4 and 6. 1993 sums to 22 and stops there; reducing on to 4 gives another card. Root 8 is Strength in the Rider-Waite-Smith numbering used here, and Justice in Marseille packs.

The rule is a twentieth-century convention found in no early tarot source.

Results include an attribution line and a permalink.

date.description: Birth date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Example: "1994-06-05" (reduces to 7, The Chariot). Time and place change nothing.
